shots.primary: The deepest point is 11 km down.
shots.say: The ocean's deepest point plunges almost eleven kilometers, deeper than the tallest mountain is high.

shots.primary: Half your oxygen comes from the sea.
shots.say: Here's the wild part. Every second breath you take comes from the ocean, made by microscopic drifting plankton.

image.gen: photorealistic sunlit ocean surface seen from just below the waterline, golden light rays, floating plankton particles, serene, cinematic, no text, no watermark

shots.primary: We've mapped less than a quarter of it.
shots.say: And most of it is still a mystery. We have mapped more of the moon than our own sea floor.
